Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Redwood demo follow-up

Hi Alice - great to meet with you and the team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from Redwood: 

- Recap: demo covered latency/cost benefits, routing/fallback policies, and Dedicated options for predictable throughput.
- Goal: understand your buying process and map stakeholders so we can surface the right procurement/security artifacts and schedule intros.

Could you help with the following items so we can put together a short mutual action plan (MAP)?
1) Org chart or list of stakeholders for this initiative (economic buyer, procurement, legal/compliance, engineering owner, relevant business owners).
2) Procurement / legal contacts (emails) and any SOW/contracting cadence details.
3) Target decision timeline and any required security/compliance docs (e.g., SOC 2, data residency).

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I attached a quick stakeholder template to make it easy to populate - can you drop into the sheet and share? [Attachment: stakeholder-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)]
- Rishi (cc'd) will send a short security one-pager and suggested MAP.
- If convenient, could we schedule a 30-min intro with procurement + legal and the economic buyer next week (Thu/Fri)? We can be flexible on timing.

Thanks - appreciate the quick help here.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
